biggest_catch: The $90 arrives late: it is deposited 60 days after the new member account qualifies, and the friend must open a share account, enroll in e-statements, and sign in to online banking within 60 days of account opening for anything to pay.
catches: Referring member must have an account in good standing, receive e-statements, and have signed up for online banking before earning the cash bonus.

Friend must provide the referrer's name at account opening; within the first 60 days, open and deposit at least $5 into the Primary Share Account, sign up for e-statements, and sign in to online banking.
A cash bonus of $90 is deposited into the referring member's savings account 60 days after the New Referred Member Offer is qualified.
Limit five referral bonuses per year; membership eligibility and account requirements apply; offer may be amended, suspended, or discontinued at any time without notice.
